purpose: Document first-party Matara/Sri Lanka cadastral-service discovery and bounded anonymous access attempts.
assessment: Official Sri Lanka Survey Department cadastral/LIS custody and Registrar General's Department Matara registry coverage are evidenced. The current public NSDI Parcel Fabrics layer was inspected, but its advertised extent excludes the unchanged Matara WUP point and the bounded anonymous query returned zero features. Survey Department SLCadastre and KML routes returned HTTP 406. No parcel polygon was retained; runtime remains held.
registryAssessment: National cadastral custody is evidenced by Survey Department cadastral-survey and LIS pages. Matara is explicitly listed on the official RGD e-Land land-registry page. This establishes a registry/cadastre custodian, not a verified Matara-local public vector endpoint.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Survey Department cadastral-survey page describes cadastral maps, parcel-based LIS, and Bimsaviya sources.
Official Survey Department LIS page describes national parcel information and public parcel visualization/KML capabilities.
Official Registrar General's Department e-Land page includes Matara among land-registry locations.
Official Sri Lanka NSDI page publishes the Planning Cadastre WMS/ArcGIS resource.
Official ArcGIS layer metadata: Parcel Fabrics polygon layer, EPSG:4326, candidate native fields, and extent north of Matara.
